zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 7 (not a guest cabin deck), obstructing views from decks directly above and below.
zones.effect: Cabins on Deck 5 look up at boat hulls; Decks 6 and 8 have partial to full obstruction depending on exact position, with horizon often clear but the view straight down or at a shallow angle blocked.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to anyone who paid for an oceanview or balcony expecting unobstructed water views; inside cabin guests are unaffected. Deck 8 balconies are most impacted as they sit just above the boat line.

zones.what: Garden Café (buffet) sits directly above on Deck 12, open long hours from early breakfast through late-night snacks.
zones.effect: Foot traffic, chair scraping, and service activity audible from cabins below, particularly during breakfast and lunch rushes; continues until late evening.
zones.mattersTo: Light sleepers and anyone sensitive to overhead noise should avoid; heavy sleepers and those spending days ashore may not notice.

zones.what: Bliss Lounge and Bar sits on Deck 11 directly above, operating into late night hours.
zones.effect: Music, dancing, and bar activity create noise and vibration below, particularly Thursday through Saturday nights and sea days.
zones.mattersTo: Anyone wanting quiet evenings should avoid this section; those out late themselves or using earplugs may be fine.

zones.what: Stardust Theater sits on Deck 6 and Deck 7, two to three decks below these cabins.
zones.effect: Show audio and bass can transmit upward during evening performances, though distance reduces impact compared to cabins on the theater decks themselves.
zones.mattersTo: Minor concern for sensitive sleepers during showtimes (typically 7:30 and 9:30 PM); most guests report minimal disturbance at this distance.

zones.what: Haven courtyard pool and hot tubs sit on Deck 14, with private sundeck areas.
zones.effect: The two Deck 15 forward Haven suites sit directly above the Haven pool area, so daytime pool activity is audible; Deck 14 cabins surround the courtyard.
zones.mattersTo: Haven guests expect this communal outdoor space; it's a feature of the complex, not a bug, though light sleepers may hear morning pool setup.

zones.what: Primary elevator banks run mid-ship on all main guest cabin decks, with stairwells adjacent.
zones.effect: Cabins immediately adjacent to elevator lobbies offer maximum convenience but experience door chimes, conversation, and foot traffic 24/7; cabins further fore or aft are quieter but mean longer walks.
zones.mattersTo: Mobility-limited guests benefit from elevator-adjacent cabins; light sleepers and those valuing quiet should choose cabins away from mid-ship elevator cores.

zones.what: Engine room sits low and aft; these are the lowest guest decks in the aft section.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum may be noticeable underway, particularly at higher speeds or during maneuvering; typically felt more than heard.
zones.mattersTo: Vibration-sensitive guests should avoid; many guests don't notice or find the hum soothing; worst in aft cabins on Deck 4.

zones.what: Bow thrusters are located low and forward, used during docking and maneuvering in port.
zones.effect: Loud mechanical grinding during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning and evening; silent during sea days and while at dock.
zones.mattersTo: Anyone wanting to sleep through port arrival should avoid; those already awake for arrival won't care; Deck 4 forward is loudest.

zones.what: Anchor chain locker sits in the bow below Deck 6 forward suites.
zones.effect: Loud rattling and vibration every time the anchor drops or is raised, typically early morning in port; brief but very loud.
zones.mattersTo: The nine forward suites on Deck 6 experience this; it's a few minutes of noise per port call, so matters only to very light sleepers or those who value quiet mornings highly.
